name: Ashby Job Board
summary: A company's public Ashby job board: listed roles with descriptions, location, workplace type and optional compensation.
notes: The public posting API needs no key; the docs list no authentication for it. Ashby's authenticated ATS API is not in this entry.
One call per company: the board name is the slug in jobs.ashbyhq.com/<name>.

endpoints.name: List a company's job postings
endpoints.summary: Every posting on the board: title, department, team, location(s), workplaceType, employmentType, descriptions, jobUrl and applyUrl.

job_board_name.description: The organization's Ashby jobs page name: Ashby for jobs.ashbyhq.com/Ashby.

includeCompensation.description: true adds compensation tiers and summary components (type, interval, currency, min and max).

notes: isListed false means the job is meant to be reachable only by direct link.
Compensation is omitted unless includeCompensation=true; the docs' field table puts it under jobs[] while the example shows it at the top level, so check both.
